title: Two-level PE Wells
subtitle: PE likelihood and investigation pathway
typeLabel: Investigation pathway — not a rule-out score
summary: Two-level PE Wells categorises suspected pulmonary embolism as likely or unlikely and directs the required investigation pathway.
population: People in whom pulmonary embolism remains clinically suspected.

criteria.label: Clinical signs and symptoms of DVT
An alternative diagnosis is less likely than PE
Immobilisation for at least 3 days or surgery in previous 4 weeks
Malignancy: treatment within 6 months or palliative

results.label: PE unlikely
interpretation: D-dimer is generally required unless PERC has already validly ruled out PE.

overrides: Both categories require the appropriate D-dimer or imaging pathway.
limitations: The Wells score does not exclude PE by itself. Do not use it to justify scene discharge without completing the required pathway.

clinicalValidation.reviewNotes: Formal clinical verification has not yet been recorded. Population, exclusions, thresholds, calculations, wording and implementation tests must be checked against the cited source.
